Corollary
[even-dimensional pinched curvature finiteness]

Source: petersen:page-0445 ↗ thm:pet-ch11-convergence-theorem-riemannian-geometry 1. ch11:11.4.8For $n\ge 1$ and $k>0$, the class of Riemannian $2n$-manifolds satisfying $k\le \sec \le 1$ is compact in the $C^{1,\alpha }$ topology and hence contains only finitely many diffeomorphism types (using the diameter bound in positive curvature and Klingenberg's injectivity-radius estimate).
